method.primary_discovery: Read cue text in recording order; search Parakeet for casting speech cues and rhyme/magic-word language; inspect selected surrounding turns.
method.speech_pattern: rhym|magic words|incantation|i say|and say|i shout|i yell|i mutter|i chant|i whisper|yelling
method.secondary_discovery: Both exports searched for hocus/pocus/abracad/alakaz/bipp/bibb/presto/rhym/poem and spell/words co-occurrence; selected matches inspected in context. Additional early spell-name/Scott-turn searches.
method.cue_joining: Selected consecutive cues joined only in temporary reading views, retaining episode, cue IDs, clock and diarizer changes.
method.limitation: Keyword search and selected-passage review, not exhaustive phrase recovery or complete reading of every export.
